products.name: Heavyweight Crewneck
products.oneLiner: Bold fleece with a hypnotic electronic pulse.
products.supplierBrief: 12–14 oz fleece crewneck, embroidered chest mark, numbered neck label, limited run.

description.text: A thick, matte fleece sweatshirt in deep purple features a subtle, geometric chest motif in hot pink and cyan. The texture feels substantial and warm, evoking a sense of calm focus within a chaotic electronic soundscape. A small yellow detail near the hem adds a sharp, bright accent to the overall muted, immersive tone, creating a balanced visual rhythm that feels both modern and deeply atmospheric.

products.name: Embroidered Patch Set
products.oneLiner: Rugged embroidered patches with electric, angular energy.
products.supplierBrief: Set of 2 iron-on embroidered patches, 3 in, merrowed border, digitizing fee applies.

description.text: Two sturdy, iron-on patches with merrowed borders in dark purple display sharp, angular geometric shapes inspired by electronic waveforms. The embroidery utilizes vibrant cyan and hot pink threads to create a high-contrast, vibrating effect against the fabric. The design feels like a fragment of a digital circuit, offering a tactile, industrial aesthetic that resonates with a raw, energetic vibe suitable for jackets and bags.

products.name: Heavyweight Tee
products.oneLiner: Soft cotton with a pulsing, neon graphic.
products.supplierBrief: 6.5 oz cotton tee, 1–2 colour screen print front, small back print, sizes S–XXL.

description.text: A structured cotton t-shirt in deep purple features a large, screen-printed abstract pattern on the chest. The design incorporates flowing lines in cyan and hot pink, suggesting the movement of sound waves or light. A tiny yellow accent sits near the bottom hem, adding a subtle pop. The overall look is clean and impactful, balancing soft fabric with a bold, hypnotic visual rhythm that feels both retro and futuristic.

products.name: Enamel Pin Set
products.oneLiner: Glossy enamel pins with sharp, digital geometry.
products.supplierBrief: Set of 3 hard-enamel pins, 1.25 in, butterfly clasps, mold fee applies.

description.text: Three small, hard-enamel pins feature intricate, pixelated geometric designs in cyan, hot pink, and yellow. The glossy enamel surface catches the light, enhancing the electronic, digital feel of the motifs. Each pin has a metallic border that frames the vibrant colors, creating a crisp, collectible look. The designs evoke the precision of synthwave aesthetics, offering a tiny, wearable nod to the hypnotic nature of electronic music production.

products.name: Sticker Pack
products.oneLiner: Waterproof vinyl stickers with glowing, abstract shapes.
products.supplierBrief: Die-cut or kiss-cut vinyl stickers, 3 designs, waterproof, 100 min run.

description.text: A sheet of die-cut vinyl stickers displays three distinct, abstract designs in hot pink, cyan, and yellow. The shapes suggest rhythmic pulses or digital glitches, rendered with smooth, flowing lines against a deep purple background. The glossy finish of the vinyl adds a layer of shine, making the colors pop vividly. The overall aesthetic is playful yet sophisticated, perfectly capturing the energetic and hypnotic spirit of electronic music in a durable, everyday format.

products.name: Cassette-Style USB
products.oneLiner: Retro cassette shape with modern, electric colors.
products.supplierBrief: Cassette-style 8 GB USB pre-loaded with the artist's own tracks, printed J-card insert.

description.text: A compact, cassette-shaped USB drive in deep purple plastic features a label design with sweeping cyan and hot pink curves. The familiar form factor evokes nostalgia, while the vibrant color palette injects a modern, electronic energy. A small yellow detail on the side adds a dash of brightness. The object feels like a bridge between analog warmth and digital precision, offering a tangible, collectible item that resonates with lovers of electronic music history.

products.name: Embroidered Corduroy Cap
products.oneLiner: Soft corduroy cap with a subtle, neon motif.
products.supplierBrief: Unstructured 6-panel corduroy cap, flat embroidery up to 3 colours, digitizing fee applies.

description.text: An unstructured, six-panel corduroy cap in deep purple features a small, flat embroidery on the front. The motif is a simple, geometric shape in cyan and hot pink, evoking a calm, hypnotic electronic rhythm. The soft texture of the corduroy contrasts with the crisp, bright threads, creating a cozy yet stylish look. A tiny yellow accent completes the design, keeping the overall aesthetic understated and sophisticated.
